messages:
olivia-support: Heads up — customer reported their JSON output changed immediately after we rolled model to redwood-llama-3-finetune-quant on their Dedicated instance. Previously their /generate with structured_output produced numeric 'qty' and non-null 'id'. Now 'qty' is a string and 'id' is null for many items. Sending repro below.

eng-ml-raj: thanks — do we have the exact model tag, and the request_id from their failing calls? also want the simple prompt + params to repro locally.

olivia-support: model tag: redwood-llama-3-finetune-quant@2026-03-12-22:14. customer request_id: r-0a1b2c3d. Minimal repro request (cURL):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{
    "model":"redwood-llama-3-finetune-quant@2026-03-12-22:14",
    "input": "Generate order items JSON for an order with 2 items",
    "structured_output": true,
    "json_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"}}}}} 
  }'
```
Observed response (customer):
```json
{
  "items": [
    {"id": null, "qty": "2", "meta": "sources:chat"},
    {"id": "SKU-123", "qty": "1"}
  ],
  "warnings": ["wrapped_with_metadata_v2"]
}
```

olivia-support: note the extra 'meta' key and the wrapper warning. Their app is strict JSON schema validated and crashes.

ryan-oncall: quick mitigation: set model pin back to redwood-llama-3-2.0 on their Dedicated pool or enable the customer's tolerant parser. can we confirm whether this was a model-side generation shift or runtime post-processing?

eng-ml-raj: hypothesis: the new finetune adds a small response template that wraps outputs with metadata and sometimes emits numbers as strings. Could be tokenizer/formatter change in the model output layer (our post-processor expects numeric tokens, but generator is emitting quoted digits). I need a diff of the model's response-formatting patch.

deveng_james: can you paste a raw streaming chunk (if available) or logs from the runtime that show the pre-postprocessor payload? streaming chunks often reveal if quotes are injected at generation time.

olivia-support: customer provided the raw stream (trimmed):
```
[STREAM] {"items": [{"id": null, "qty": "2"}, {"id": "SKU-123", "qty": "1"}], "meta":{}}
[POSTPROC] applied wrapper: wrapped_with_metadata_v2
```

eng-ml-raj: OK, that's the model emitting quoted digits. Repro locally with same model tag reproduces it for me too. Short-term fix: add a postproc rule to coerce numeric strings to ints when schema expects integer. I'll open an internal PR to add a safe coercion step for Structured Output when json_schema is provided.

pm-anya: please create a customer-facing incident/Ticket and include rollback option. we should also schedule a rollback on Dedicated if the patch PR can't land in <24h. Customer SLA impacted.

support-bot: Escalation created: INC-2026-435. Notifying #eng-ml and #dedicated-ops.

olivia-support: CC'd the customer with a temporary workaround (pin to previous model) and ETA ~6-12h for a postproc patch. Will update here when PR is merged.

ryan-oncall: after the PR, run a regression test suite with the customer's schema set (olivia, can you get their example prompt set uploaded to the test bucket?).

olivia-support: uploading now to s3://redwood-customer-repro/acme/order-schema-set.tar.gz. link: https://s3.redwood.ai/acme/order-schema-set.tar.gz

eng-ml-raj: thanks — next steps: (1) hotfix postproc coercion + add unit tests, (2) run regression on Dedicated pool, (3) if hotfix insufficient, schedule model rollback. I'll post PR link once ready.

deveng_james: also adding a quick lint rule to warn if model adds metadata wrappers when structured_output=true. could save us similar surprises.

olivia-support: any ETA on PR? customer is getting error spikes in prod.

eng-ml-raj: targeting PR in 3 hours, hotfix deploy after review ~6 hours. will ping here with commit hash.

pm-anya: thanks all. keep this thread updated; I'll join the customer call at 1600 PST if needed.
